summary: Each array is a nonempty subset of the nine digits 1 through 9, so an execution examines at most eighteen digit entries and the legal domain cannot support meaningful asymptotic runtime scaling.

workload_bound.source_constraint: each input contains unique digits from 1 through 9 and has length at most 9

replacement_checks.evidence: Two arrays of at most nine unique decimal digits contain at most eighteen entries in total.
The package verification compares every ordered pair of nonempty digit subsets against direct enumeration of all one- and two-digit candidates.
